items.title: One of my enjoyable experiences on the NBA beat, besides covering Don Nelson, was talking to his son, Donnie. Donnie always referred to his father as "Nellie," and frequently had to undo something Nellie had done or said. The child was father to this man. RIP to one of a kind.
